title: Effect of sintering temperature on microstructure and mechanical properties of MoNbVTa0.5Cr high-entropy alloys fabricated by powder metallurgy method
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) for 60 h at 350 rpm under Ar gas protection, followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1500 ℃ with a heating rate of 100 ℃/min and axial pressure of 40 MPa for 10 min.
